name: metamodel.changeType
title: Change type definition
summary: Change the name, description, meaning, prefix, parent type or the abstract mark of a type; only the metamodel file that has it changes, line by line.
details: Each given field replaces the line of that field in the type's definition, in the file it is in (SR-236 AK3, AK4); a missing field line is added after the definition's last line, and null removes it (`abstract: false` removes the abstract line; a field that already has the value is left as it is). Every other line stays as it was; no element file changes and nothing in Git (D-036), and the key stays (D-043). Name, description and meaning change at any time, and so does removing the abstract mark (SR-237 AK2, AK3). The prefix changes and the type becomes abstract only while no element has the type (SR-236 AK7, SR-237 AK3). A new, changed or removed `extends` is refused when the type or a type that extends it loses a property that an element of such a type holds, or a status that one has (SR-237 AK4); new inherited required properties are counted in `missingRequired` (SR-015 AK3). The metamodel files are read again before the change, and the metamodel afterwards is checked as a read would check it: an error refuses the command, warnings are in `problems` (SR-236 AK1). Errors: input.invalid with details.reason unknown when no type has the key (details.type); input.invalid with details.reason taken when another type has the name (in Unicode normal form NFC) or the prefix (details.field, details.type); input.invalid with details.reason in-use when elements use what the change locks or removes (details.uses: kind, key, count and the short IDs of the first 20 elements in code-unit order); file.folder-missing when such a change needs the uses and a repository of the workspace is not on this machine (details.repository, details.repositories); file.faulty when an element file cannot be read, as it may hold the definition (SR-236 AK7, SR-008 AK3; details.command, details.count: the number of these files, details.files: the first 20 by repository and path, each with repository and file), when such a change needs the uses, unless a repository is missing as well; input.invalid with details.reason metamodel-invalid and the errors in details.problems when the metamodel would have an error (such as an unknown type in `extends` or a cycle); workspace.read-only when the metamodel files do not give a valid metamodel or the metamodel repository is not on this machine; input.invalid with details.reason git-folder when the metamodel folder is .git or a repository of its own (D-036); file.read-only when the metamodel repository cannot be written (SR-018 AK2); file.faulty when the definition or a node on the way to it is an alias or has an anchor (details.repository, details.file, details.line); file.changed-on-disk when another process changed the file since it was read (SR-236 AK10). Nothing is written on these.
whileReadOnlyReason: SR-236 AK5: a metamodel that cannot be read is never changed (SR-011 AK3).

type.description: Key of the type to change.

name.description: New display name; no other type may have it.

description.description: New description, for people; null removes it.

prefix.description: New prefix of the short IDs of its elements (D-017); no other type may have it. Only while no element has the type.

extends.description: Key of the new parent type; null removes the parent. Refused while an element uses a property or status the type or a type that extends it loses.

abstract.description: true: no elements of the type can be created (SR-012 AK4), only while no element has the type; false removes the mark.

meaning.description: New built-in meaning of the type (D-012), one of `typeMeaning` of metamodel.schema.json; null removes it.

type.title: Type
type.description: The definition as it is written afterwards.

items.description: Written file, relative to the workspace root.

versionsChanged.title: Versions changed
versionsChanged.description: Elements whose version is another under the new metamodel (SR-015 AK4): elements of a type whose counted properties change and that have a value for one of them, such as elements of a type that was unknown before; those of `versionsChangedElements`.

missingRequired.title: Missing required properties
missingRequired.description: Elements that now miss a value of a required property they did not miss before (SR-015 AK3); those of `missingRequiredElements`.

versionsChangedElements.title: Elements with another version
versionsChangedElements.description: The elements `versionsChanged` counts, in store order.

missingRequiredElements.title: Elements missing a required property
missingRequiredElements.description: The elements `missingRequired` counts, in store order.

problems.title: Problems
problems.description: The warnings of the metamodel afterwards (SR-236 AK1).
